events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Gila County in east central Arizona...
Navajo County in north central Arizona...
Apache County in northeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 300 PM MST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of creeks and normally dry washes is imminent or
occurring. Deadly flooding over low-water crossings.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 829 AM MST, River levels on the Little Colorado River and East
Fork White River are dropping, but continue to indicate elevated
flow. Flooding is ongoing in the warned area.
- This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River, Black River, White River, Show Low Creek,
Zuqi River, Zui River, Diamond Creek, Puerco River, and Nutrioso
Creek.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Whiteriver, Springerville, Eagar, St. Johns, North Fork, Canyon
Day, Rainbow City, Seven Mile, East Fork, McNary, Turkey Creek,
Alpine, Fort Apache, Greer, Vernon, Concho, Nahata Dziil, Feaster
and Tenney Pond.
- This includes the following highways...
State Route 261 between mile markers 395 and 412. State Route 260
between mile markers 361 and 398. Highway 60 between mile markers
358 and 401. State Route 73 between mile markers 326 and 353.
Highway 191 161 between mile markers 316 and 366. State Route 61
between mile markers 357 and 430. State Route 473 between mile
markers 0 and 10. State Route 373 between mile markers 386 and
390. Highway 191 between mile markers 248 and 253. Highway 180
191 between mile markers 371 and 433. Highway 180 between mile
markers 336 and 368. State Route 273 between mile markers 378 and
396.

- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Downstream tidal effects on the St John River have slowed flow at
Astor. Heavy rainfall will lead to additional rises within Moderate
flood stage.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 4.0 feet, Major flooding occurs with water entering
many structures on canals and along the river. Long duration
flooding will occur, with levels taking weeks to months to return
below flood stage. Water rescues will be necessary. River Road
becomes inaccessible, with 1 to 2 feet water depth in numerous
homes on Wildhog, Possum, and Bonnet roads. Roads along Blue Creek
are inaccessible with major flooding of homes on Otter, Branch and
Chestnut roads. Camp South Moon Road and Juno Trail are
inaccessible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:30 AM EST Monday the stage was 3.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:30 AM EST Monday was 3.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crests of 3.8 feet
just after midnight tonight with additional tidal crest forecast
through Moderate flood stage this week.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
